title: Turkish Cheese Flatbread
description: A simple and delicious Turkish-inspired cheese flatbread recipe. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Open the flatbread mix and follow the instructions to make the dough.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Mix the crumbled feta cheese and Turkish feta cheese spice blend in a bowl.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough over the cheese mixture to create a crust.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Cut the flatbread into wedges and serve warm.
